features.label: 应用流程
features.description: 管理状态和时钟，通过公开系统集配置跨功能顺序。

features.label: 第一人称控制
features.description: 控制者动作、鼠标捕获、人物朝向、相机和视觉隐藏。

features.label: 角色运动
features.description: 角色组件、固定步运动、物理状态观察与会话意图清理；不安装其他项目插件。

features.label: 物品交互
features.description: 拾取、共享持握、安全转向查询、清理和物品反馈。

features.label: 物理基础
features.description: 安装 Avian、重力同步、外部变化的提前唤醒与统一物理日志。

features.label: 越界恢复
features.description: 固定步落水恢复与插值暂停生命周期。

features.label: 场景装配
features.description: 运行 GLB 强句柄、加载轮询、BSN 海岛和静态碰撞装配。

features.label: 角色动画
features.description: 命名动作绑定、状态混合与鞋底补偿。

features.label: 菜单与界面
features.description: BSN 菜单、设置草稿、导航、指针和独立展示舞台。

features.label: 音频播放
features.description: Kira 播放、预加载、混音、并发与退出停止。

features.label: 设置与参数
features.description: 设置持久化、原型参数、限帧与固定时钟初始化日志。

features.label: 世界检查器
features.description: 安装 Egui 与世界检查器；面板只在 Running 显示。

features.label: 会话日志
features.description: 在其他引擎插件之前安装真实 LogPlugin；主入口持有退出守卫。

features.label: 窗口策略
features.description: 窗口线程安装、刷新与清理原生 16:9 策略。

entities.name: 键盘控制者
entities.description: 输入上下文实体，保存 PlayerId { id: 1 }、设备选择和控制目标。控制者与角色、相机是独立实体。 仅在 InGame 存在，Paused 保留；退出 InGame 时清理。
entities.display_summary: 保存玩家身份、输入上下文与受控角色及相机。

components.name: Name
fields: 名称: String
components.description: 用于日志与调试的控制者名称。

components.name: PlayerId
components.description: 独立于运行时 Entity 的业务身份。

components.name: GameplayContext
components.description: Enhanced Input 上下文标记；不是角色组件。
components.display_summary: 标记用于玩法动作的控制上下文。

components.name: GamepadDevice
fields: 当前值: None
components.description: 当前上下文不用手柄；键盘与鼠标绑定不受此项关闭。
components.display_summary: 配置玩法上下文的手柄输入来源。

components.name: ControlsCharacter
fields: character: Entity
components.description: 普通实体引用，指向受控角色。

components.name: ControlsCamera
fields: camera: Entity
components.description: 普通实体引用，指向受控相机。

components.name: Actions<GameplayContext>
fields: 动作实体集合: Vec<Entity>
components.description: ActionOf<GameplayContext> 自动反向索引，当前四个玩法动作。MenuContext 是独立持久控制者。
components.display_summary: 索引控制上下文拥有的动作实体。

components.name: ContextPriority<GameplayContext>
fields: 优先级: usize
components.description: 注册输入上下文时要求的组件，决定上下文评估优先级；当前使用默认值。

components.name: ContextActivity<GameplayContext>

components.description: 菜单、暂停、失焦、控制关联失效或检查器模式停用玩法上下文；通过 Commands 替换，动作完成／取消清零持续意图，恢复遵循 require_reset。

components.name: DespawnOnExit

components.description: 状态退出销毁此根；内置 ChildOf 子树随根清理。
components.display_summary: 标记退出游戏会话时清理控制者。

entities.name: 角色业务根实体
entities.description: 动态角色根对应脚底。Position/Rotation 与速度由 Avian 管理；Transform 是插值呈现，水平朝向受镜头控制。 仅在 InGame 存在，Paused 保留；退出 InGame 时清理。

components.name: Name
fields: 名称: String

components.name: Character

components.name: Transform

rotation: Quat

components.description: Avian 固定步回写与渲染帧插值的呈现姿态；物理位置来源是 Position，非持握系统直接搬动。
components.display_summary: 保存角色经插值生成的显示姿态。

components.name: HoldingItems

components.name: ComputedMass

components.name: ComputedCenterOfMass

components.name: CollisionLayers

components.description: 请求离散接触开始/结束消息，用于集中日志。

components.name: SweptCcd

components.description: 按身体最薄尺寸的半厚度门槛自动启用非线性扫掠；显式包含动态、运动学、静态和独立碰撞体，避免只采用新版默认静态/运动学过滤。

components.name: Friction
fields: 系数=0；Min 合并规则

mouse_capture.name: sync_mouse_capture
mouse_capture.description: 按 F3、窗口焦点、游戏状态和控制关联切换光标捕获，统一设置 GameplayContext 活动与 Egui 输入转发；主菜单和暂停始终释放光标。
mouse_capture.display_summary: 管理光标捕获及玩法输入启停。
filters:
pub(super) fn sync_mouse_capture(
    mut commands: Commands,
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    mut focus_events: MessageReader<WindowFocused>,
    mut windows: Query<(Entity, &Window, &mut CursorOptions), With<PrimaryWindow>>,
    controllers: Query<
        (
            Entity,
            &ControlsCharacter,
            &ControlsCamera,
            &ContextActivity<GameplayContext>,
        ),
        With<GameplayContext>,
    >,
    characters: Query<(), With<Character>>,
    mut cameras: Query<(Entity, &FirstPersonCamera, &mut MouseLookState)>,
    mut egui_contexts: Query<(&mut EguiContextSettings, &mut EguiInput), With<PrimaryEguiContext>>,
    app_state: Option<Res<State<AppState>>>,
    play_state: Option<Res<State<PlayState>>>,
)
窗口：With<PrimaryWindow>，要求唯一
控制者：With<GameplayContext>
角色：Query<(), With<Character>>，只验证实体存在
相机：具有 FirstPersonCamera 与 MouseLookState
UI：With<PrimaryEguiContext>，遍历已有主上下文
events: 恢复捕获时向 EguiInput.events 追加 egui::Event::PointerGone；不是 Bevy Event 或 Message
notes: 显式 after(InputSystems)、after(EguiPreUpdateSet::InitContexts)、before(EguiPreUpdateSet::ProcessInput) 与 before(EnhancedInputSystems::Prepare)。
F3 独立于 GameplayContext 切换游戏与检查器输入归属；检查器两种模式下均可显示，点击面板内外不切换模式。
CursorOptions、MouseLookState、EguiContextSettings 与 EguiInput 直接修改；ContextActivity 是不可变组件，通过 Commands 替换，并在动作 Prepare 前应用。
捕获时关闭主 Egui 上下文的指针、滚轮、键盘与输入法转发；恢复捕获时追加 PointerGone 清除遗留悬停，不终止拖拽或文本编辑。切换前须结束其他输入手势。
失焦、菜单、暂停或控制关联失效释放捕获并停用玩法上下文；回焦后由 F3 恢复，从暂停恢复则重新初始化捕获。Esc 暂停由菜单动作处理，底层 Esc 只释放光标。
停用上下文不清空 ButtonInput；动作完成或取消清除持续移动轴，重新启用仍遵循 require_reset。

bodyOperations.condition: 主窗口不可用时停用原本活动的控制上下文。
相机捕获、角色绑定、游戏状态或窗口焦点导致上下文活动状态变化。

held_apply.description: 应用拿放关系与刚体移除，以及 Avian Observer 的延迟归属清理，使后续呈现与共享挂接读取最新状态。
held_apply.display_summary: 使拿放后的关系与刚体变更对后续系统可见。
notes: 公开固定步系统集的 chain 在需要的位置应用延迟命令；交互先于目标和挂接。
箱体真实姿态在拾取时保留，随后沿碰撞安全小步对齐。

held_fixed.name: sync_held_presentation
held_fixed.description: 按本帧人物呈现 Transform 与唯一挂接局部姿态直接同步独立箱根 Transform，同时更新握持检查目标 HeldTarget。
held_fixed.display_summary: 按人物呈现姿态同步持物模型与握持目标。
filters:
pub(super) fn sync_held_presentation(
    config: Res<PrototypeConfig>,
    holders: Query<&Transform, (With<Character>, Without<Pickable>)>,
    mut items: Query<
        (
            &HeldBy,
            Option<&HeldAttachment>,
            Option<&CarryGrip>,
            &mut HeldTarget,
            &mut Transform,
        ),
        (With<Pickable>, Without<Character>),
    >,
)
角色：(With<Character>, Without<Pickable>)
物体：(With<Pickable>, Without<Character>)，具有 HeldBy 与 HeldTarget
run_if(gameplay_running)：AppState::InGame 且 PlayState::Running；独立无状态测试兼容运行。
notes: 角色 With<Character>/Without<Pickable>；箱体 With<Pickable>/Without<Character>，挂接可选。
HeldTarget 仅握持检查目标；箱体实际姿态来自 HeldAttachment.local_pose，对齐期间两者可不同。
不积分运动、不施力、不消费交互；同一局部姿态是模拟/显示唯一来源。
FixedGameplaySystems::Motion / Interaction / Target 最后一步；交互命令已应用，后续 ItemInteractionPlugin 完成挂接与对齐。
sourceGaps: 待核实：Transform 的 read 操作尚未确定实体投影，未据此建立具体投影关系。
待核实：Character 的 filter 操作尚未确定实体投影，未据此建立具体投影关系。

facing_update.name: sync_character_facing
facing_update.description: 消费完整有符号转向，检查持物旋转路径；真实受阻先在安全旧姿态释放箱体，随后人物转向，镜头保持自由。
facing_update.display_summary: 同步人物朝向并处理持物转向受阻。
filters:
pub(super) fn sync_character_facing(
    mut commands: Commands,
    controllers: Query<(&ControlsCharacter, &ControlsCamera), With<GameplayContext>>,
    mut cameras: Query<&mut FirstPersonCamera>,
    mut characters: Query<(&mut Transform, &Position, Option<&HoldingItems>), With<Character>>,
    items: Query<(
        &Collider,
        &HeldAttachment,
        &LinearVelocity,
        &AngularVelocity,
    )>,
    names: Query<&Name>,
    collision: CarryRotationQuery,
)
控制者：With<GameplayContext>
角色：With<Character>
要求 FirstPersonCamera.target == ControlsCharacter.character
run_if(gameplay_running)：AppState::InGame 且 PlayState::Running；独立无状态测试兼容运行。
notes: pending_yaw_delta 用 mem::take 消费一次，保留方向、180°和完整一圈路径，不因多固定步重复消费。
CarryRotationQuery 是 SystemParam：Avian 空间树筛选候选，再以真实形状检查连续路径；排除自身组合、Sensor、ColliderDisabled，并检查碰撞层交互。
Commands 在后续持物同步前应用；释放保留转动前安全世界姿态、尺度及动量，并记录 blocker / blocker_name / yaw_delta。
显示链 .chain()：朝向 → sync_held_physics → sync_held_presentation → 镜头 → 可见性；after(Ease)、before(UpdateEasingTick)。

bodyOperations.condition: 输入转向或当前安全朝向需要更新。
持箱旋转路径受阻，接受自动卸载结果后。

physics_step.name: PhysicsSystems::StepSimulation
physics_step.description: 运行宽/窄阶段、子步求解、重力积分、碰撞与睡眠（引擎概览）。
physics_step.display_summary: 执行碰撞求解、重力积分与刚体运动。
notes: PhysicsSchedule 嵌套于 StepSimulation；内部有求解子步，不等于一个普通业务函数。
碰撞消息按 CollisionEventsEnabled 策略产生；力本步连续作用，物理步后清理累计。
ColliderTreePlugin 在 PhysicsSchedule 的 BroadPhase 更新 AABB/树，在 Finalize 之后、Last 之前再次更新求解体 AABB；结构、碰撞层与 Sensor 的框架 Observer 也维护 ColliderTrees。此概览不新增项目 Observer。
Avian 0.8 使用默认 6 个求解子步；项目没有覆盖 SubstepCount。
CCD 在刚体层遍历 RigidBodyColliders；人物的 SpeculativeCcd / SweptCcd 配置也覆盖持物代理，不在代理上重复装配这些组件。
PhysicsSchedule 在 PhysicsStepSystems::Last 之后执行 update_last_physics_tick，记录本次物理末尾的系统变更 tick。
BodySizeMetricsPlugin 在 PhysicsSchedule 的 Solver 前，按变化的质心或 Collider 重算 CCD 厚度与扫掠半径。

Back 重置草稿；成功 Apply 更新 GameSettings；保存失败保留草稿及预览，退出设置由 AudioMix 回滚。

filters:
fn wake_changed_bodies(
    mut commands: Commands,
    bodies: Query<
        (
            Entity,
            Ref<Position>,
            Ref<Rotation>,
            Ref<LinearVelocity>,
            Ref<AngularVelocity>,
            Ref<SleepTimer>,
        ),
        (
            With<Sleeping>,
            Or<(
                Changed<Position>,
                Changed<Rotation>,
                Changed<LinearVelocity>,
                Changed<AngularVelocity>,
                Changed<SleepTimer>,
            )>,
        ),
    >,
    last_physics_tick: Res<LastPhysicsTick>,
    system_tick: SystemChangeTick,
)
With<Sleeping>
Or<(Changed<Position>, Changed<Rotation>, Changed<LinearVelocity>, Changed<AngularVelocity>, Changed<SleepTimer>)>
Ref<T> 仅读取 last_changed 元数据，不读取这些组件的业务字段。
任一变更 tick.is_newer_than(LastPhysicsTick.0, SystemChangeTick::this_run()) 才排队。
notes: 无 gameplay_running 条件；实际注册在 FixedPostUpdate 的 PhysicsSystems::First，并显式 before(PhysicsSystems::Prepare)。
本函数不直接写入物理组件；writes 汇总排队 WakeBody 的已核实间接效果。命令应用时唤醒整个相关物理岛，不只目标 Entity。
WakeBody → WakeIslands 重置 SleepTimer、移除 Sleeping；Avian 的 Remove<Sleeping> Observer 再插入 SolverBodyIndex。未展开其内部全部岛、接触图与约束图资源。
LastPhysicsTick 在 PhysicsSchedule 的 Last 之后更新；早于该 tick 的引擎回写不会再次唤醒静置身体。
唯一 debug 日志记录 entity 和 reason=external_physics_change，送入现有 tracing producer。

- [`Window::present_mode`] and [`Window::composite_alpha_mode`] changes are handled by the `bevy_render` crate.

- [`Window::canvas`] cannot be changed after the window is created.
- [`Window::focused`] cannot be manually changed to `false` after the window is created.

源码文档：Iterates through contact constraints and applies impulses to account for [`Restitution`].

Note that restitution with TGS Soft and speculative contacts may not be perfectly accurate.
This is a tradeoff, but cheap CCD is often more important than perfect restitution.

The number of iterations can be increased with [`SolverConfig::restitution_iterations`]
to apply restitution for multiple contact points more evenly.

fields:
源码文档：Performs [Continuous Collision Detection](self).

Every dynamic body whose per-frame motion is large relative to its thickness is treated
as a "fast body" and swept against static and kinematic (and optionally dynamic) bodies.

If a time of impact is found, the body's accumulated motion is scaled down so it stops
at the first impact, leaving the next frame's collision detection to resolve the contact.

The system detects window creation, resize, and scale factor change events to update the camera
[`Projection`] if needed.

inspect information about the render target. This system will not access any other image assets.

schedule-system-591c667c686ecd9c.name: check_visibility_cpu_culling
schedule-system-591c667c686ecd9c.description: 对活动相机检查实体继承可见性、渲染层、距离范围和可选包围体视锥测试，更新 ViewVisibility，并按类别合并、排序该视图的可见实体列表；保留退出 CPU 或视锥裁剪的配置差异。
schedule-system-591c667c686ecd9c.display_summary: 按层、距离和视锥收集各相机可见实体。
filters:
fn check_visibility_cpu_culling(
    mut thread_queues: Local<Parallel<TypeIdHashMap<Vec<Entity>>>>,
    mut view_query: Query<(
        Entity,
        &mut VisibleEntities,
        &Frustum,
        Option<&RenderLayers>,
        &Camera,
        Has<NoCpuCulling>,
    )>,
    mut visible_aabb_query: Query<
        (
            Entity,
            &InheritedVisibility,
            &mut ViewVisibility,
            Option<&VisibilityClass>,
            Option<&RenderLayers>,
            Option<&Aabb>,
            Option<&Sphere>,
            &GlobalTransform,
            Has<NoFrustumCulling>,
            Has<VisibilityRange>,
        ),
        Without<NoCpuCulling>,
    >,
    visible_entity_ranges: Option<Res<VisibleEntityRanges>>,
)
Without<NoCpuCulling>
fields:
源码文档：System updating the visibility of entities, other than those that have opted
out of CPU culling, each frame.

The system is part of the [`VisibilitySystems::CheckVisibility`] set. Each
frame, it updates the [`ViewVisibility`] of all entities, and for each view
also compute the [`VisibleEntities`] for that view.

To ensure that an entity is checked for visibility, make sure that it has a
[`VisibilityClass`] component and that that component is nonempty.

schedule-system-749fd817522ebb08.name: check_visibility_gpu_culling
schedule-system-749fd817522ebb08.description: 对新增 NoCpuCulling 或继承可见性变化的对象，把 ViewVisibility 同步为其 InheritedVisibility；不在该系统执行额外 CPU 视锥检查。
schedule-system-749fd817522ebb08.display_summary: 同步退出 CPU 裁剪对象的层级可见状态。
filters: ( With<NoCpuCulling>, Or<(Changed<InheritedVisibility>, Added<NoCpuCulling>)>, )
fields:
源码文档：Updates the visibility of entities marked with [`NoCpuCulling`].

In this case, the [`ViewVisibility`] of each such mesh simply becomes equal
to its [`InheritedVisibility`], as the CPU has been instructed to perform no
other checks. For performance, we avoid examining any entity that hasn't
changed its inherited visibility.

schedule-system-cf9509e0bd50e4d6.name: check_visibility_ranges
schedule-system-cf9509e0bd50e4d6.description: 清空旧范围结果，为最多三十二个相机或阴影 LOD 原点分配位索引，按实体原点或包围盒中心检查 VisibilityRange，并合并非零可见位掩码；不执行视锥或遮挡裁剪。
schedule-system-cf9509e0bd50e4d6.display_summary: 按视图距离计算实体可见范围位掩码。

fields:

A `Measure` is used by the UI's layout algorithm to determine the appropriate amount of space
to provide for the text given the fonts, the text itself and the constraints of the layout.

* Measures are regenerated on changes to either [`ComputedTextBlock`] or [`ComputedUiRenderTargetInfo`].
* Changes that only modify the colors of a `Text` do not require a new `Measure`. This system
  is only able to detect that a `Text` component has changed and will regenerate the `Measure` on
  color changes. This can be expensive, particularly for large blocks of text, and the [`bypass_change_detection`](bevy_ecs::change_detection::DetectChangesMut::bypass_change_detection)
  method should be called when only changing the `Text`'s colors.

fields:
源码文档：A system that ensures that [`super::mesh::extract_2d_meshes`] re-extracts
meshes whose materials changed.

As [`super::mesh::extract_2d_meshes`] only considers meshes that were newly
extracted, and it writes information from the [`RenderMaterial2dInstances`]
into the [`RenderMesh2dInstances`] resource, we must tell
[`super::mesh::extract_2d_meshes`] to re-extract a mesh if its material
changed. Otherwise, the material binding information in the
[`RenderMesh2dInstances`] might not be updated properly.  The easiest way to
ensure that [`super::mesh::extract_2d_meshes`] re-extracts a mesh is to mark
its [`Mesh2d`] as changed, so that's what this system does.

源码文档：Add new font assets to the internal font collection, and set any associated `TextFont`'s changed.
If any fonts are removed, the font collection is completely rebuilt, the generic families are remapped, and all `TextFont`s are set changed.

Font asset changes are track locally instead of waiting for asset events. Text layout also builds the atlas images, and waiting for asset events would

schedule-system-0545109e96d2f1d5.description: 对指定材质组件或其资产发生变化的网格标记 Mesh3d 已变更，使后续 GPU 网格提取刷新材质绑定等实例元数据。

filters:
fn mark_meshes_as_changed_if_their_materials_changed<M>(
    mut changed_meshes_query: Query<
        &mut Mesh3d,
        Or<(Changed<MeshMaterial3d<M>>, AssetChanged<MeshMaterial3d<M>>)>,
    >,
) where
    M: Material,
Or<(Changed<MeshMaterial3d<M>>, AssetChanged<MeshMaterial3d<M>>)>
fields:
源码文档：A system that ensures that
[`crate::render::mesh::extract_meshes_for_gpu_building`] re-extracts meshes
whose materials changed.

As [`crate::render::mesh::collect_meshes_for_gpu_building`] only considers
meshes that were newly extracted, and it writes information from the
[`RenderMaterialInstances`] into the
[`crate::render::mesh::MeshInputUniform`], we must tell
[`crate::render::mesh::extract_meshes_for_gpu_building`] to re-extract a
mesh if its material changed. Otherwise, the material binding information in
the [`crate::render::mesh::MeshInputUniform`] might not be updated properly.
The easiest way to ensure that
[`crate::render::mesh::extract_meshes_for_gpu_building`] re-extracts a mesh
is to mark its [`Mesh3d`] as changed, so that's what this system does.

fields:
源码文档：Derives per-tab state from each [`TabList`]'s [`SelectedTab`] and the current keyboard focus:

- [`Selected`] markers mirror a validated `SelectedTab` (the referenced entity must be an
  enabled direct child; anything else counts as no selection).
- [`TabIndex`] follows the roving-tabindex pattern: one tab per list is focusable (the
  focused tab, else the selected tab, else the first enabled tab), so Tab/Shift+Tab skip
  the strip while arrow keys move within it.

Runs in `PostUpdate`, early-returning unless selection, children, focus, or disabled state
changed.

源码文档：System that updates the IME candidate window position to track the text cursor.

Reads the cursor bounding area from parley's layout and transforms it to screen coordinates

composing text rather than overlapping it.

schedule-system-ada6d63d294cbbab.description: 清理上一轮的单帧键盘边沿，再根据按下或释放消息更新 KeyCode 与逻辑 Key 两份 ButtonInput；收到键盘焦点丢失时释放缓存的物理按键，避免窗口切换后残留按下状态。
schedule-system-ada6d63d294cbbab.display_summary: 把键盘事件汇总为物理和逻辑按键状态。
fields:
源码文档：Updates the [`ButtonInput<KeyCode>`] and [`ButtonInput<Key>`] resources with the latest [`KeyboardInput`] events.

## Differences

The main difference between the [`KeyboardInput`] event and the [`ButtonInput`] resources are that
the latter has convenient functions such as [`ButtonInput::pressed`], [`ButtonInput::just_pressed`] and [`ButtonInput::just_released`] and is window id agnostic.

There is a [`ButtonInput`] for both [`KeyCode`] and [`Key`] as they are both useful in different situations, see their documentation for the details.

schedule-system-8eedb18f24231759.description: 连接时给已登记的设备实体写入名称及 Gamepad 状态，断开时移除 Gamepad；保留实体和可能存在的设备设置，以便重新连接时复用。

fields:
源码文档：Handles [`GamepadConnectionEvent`]s events.

On connection, adds the components representing a [`Gamepad`] to the entity.
On disconnection, removes the [`Gamepad`] and other related components.
Entities are left alive and might leave components like [`GamepadSettings`] to preserve state in the case of a reconnection.

## Note

Whenever a [`Gamepad`] connects or disconnects, an information gets printed to the console using the [`info!`] macro.

schedule-system-a9f6d6374504e7e6.name: touch_screen_input_system
schedule-system-a9f6d6374504e7e6.description: 清理刚开始、刚结束和刚取消集合，读取 TouchInput 更新触点位置、压力与阶段；保留没有新消息但仍按住的触点，防止静止触摸被误判释放。
schedule-system-a9f6d6374504e7e6.display_summary: 维护持续触点与本帧触摸边沿。
fields:
源码文档：Updates the [`Touches`] resource with the latest [`TouchInput`] events.

This is not clearing the `pressed` collection, because it could incorrectly mark a touch input
as not pressed even though it is pressed. This could happen if the touch input is not moving
for a single frame and would therefore be marked as not pressed, because this function is
called on every single frame no matter if there was an event or not.

## Differences

The main difference between the [`TouchInput`] event and the [`Touches`] resource is that
the latter has convenient functions like [`Touches::just_pressed`] and [`Touches::just_released`].

fields:
源码文档：System that enables or disables IME on the primary window based on whether the focused entity
is an editable text field.

IME is enabled when an editable `EditableText` gains focus and disabled when focus moves
elsewhere. The IME state is also re-evaluated whenever the focused entity's read/write mode
changes. Because [`TextReadWriteMode`] is an optional component, such a change can happen when the
component is overwritten, inserted, or removed; removal reverts the effective mode to the
[`Editable`](TextReadWriteMode::Editable) default and is detected via [`RemovedComponents`].

fields:
源码文档：System that processes [`Ime`] events into [`TextEdit`] actions for the focused [`EditableText`] widget.

Preedit text (in-progress IME composition) is excluded from [`EditableText::value`].
On commit, the preedit is cleared and the committed string is inserted.

Note that this does not immediately apply the edits; they are queued up in [`EditableText::pending_edits`],
and then applied later by the [`apply_text_edits`](`bevy_text::apply_text_edits`) system.

源码文档：Reads [`WindowEvent`] messages and wraps cursor movement and mouse button input into [`EguiInputEvent`]s in the order that the operating system delivered them.

Mouse button messages do not contain a pointer position, so preserving their ordering with cursor movement messages is necessary to associate them with the correct position. Button messages can be redirected to [`HoveredNonWindowEguiContext`].

Inserts, updates or removes the [`FocusedNonWindowEguiContext`] resource based on a hovered context.

    mut mouse_button_input_messages: ResMut<Messages<MouseButtonInput>>,
)
fields:
源码文档：Clears Bevy input message buffers and resets [`ButtonInput`] resources if Egui
is using pointer or keyboard (see the [`write_egui_wants_input_system`] run condition).

This system isn't run by default, set [`EguiGlobalSettings::enable_absorb_bevy_input_system`]
to `true` to enable it.

## Considerations

Enabling this system makes an assumption that `bevy_egui` takes priority in input handling
over other plugins and systems. This should work ok as long as there's no other system
clearing messages the same way that might be in conflict with `bevy_egui`, and there's
no other system that needs a non-interrupted flow of messages.

## Alternative

A safer alternative is to apply `run_if(not(egui_wants_any_pointer_input))` or `run_if(not(egui_wants_any_keyboard_input))` to your systems
that need to be disabled while Egui is using input (see the [`egui_wants_any_pointer_input`], [`egui_wants_any_keyboard_input`] run conditions).

schedule-system-5cae27f8b077d6ac.name: solve_contacts<true>
schedule-system-5cae27f8b077d6ac.description: 迭代接触约束并向碰撞刚体施加冲量；泛型 USE_BIAS 决定是否加入重叠修正，用带偏置求解和无偏置松弛分别处理穿透与速度过冲。

filters:
fn solve_contacts<const USE_BIAS: bool>(
    mut solver_bodies: ResMut<SolverBodies>,
    mut constraint_graph: ResMut<ConstraintGraph>,
    solver_config: Res<SolverConfig>,
    length_unit: Res<PhysicsLengthUnit>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut diagnostics: ResMut<SolverDiagnostics>,
)
fields:
源码文档：Solves contacts by iterating through the given contact constraints
and applying impulses to colliding rigid bodies.

This solve is done `iterations` times. With a substepped solver,
`iterations` should typically be `1`, as substeps will handle the iteration.

If `use_bias` is `true`, the impulses will be boosted to account for overlap.
The solver should often be run twice per frame or substep: first with the bias,
and then without it to *relax* the velocities and reduce overshooting caused by
[warm starting](SubstepSolverSystems::WarmStart).

See [`SubstepSolverSystems::SolveConstraints`] and [`SubstepSolverSystems::Relax`] for more information.

fields:
源码文档：Produces a hierarchical Z-buffer (depth pyramid) for occlusion culling.

This runs the single-pass downsampling (SPD) shader with the *min* filter in
order to generate a series of mipmaps for the Z buffer. The resulting
hierarchical Z-buffer can be used for occlusion culling.

The *late* downsample depth pass runs at the end of the main phase. It
prepares the Z-buffer for the occlusion culling that the early mesh
preprocessing phase of the *next* frame will perform.

This system won't do anything if occlusion culling isn't on.

    )>,

fields:
源码文档：Produces a hierarchical Z-buffer (depth pyramid) for occlusion culling.

This runs the single-pass downsampling (SPD) shader with the *min* filter in
order to generate a series of mipmaps for the Z buffer. The resulting
hierarchical Z-buffer can be used for occlusion culling.

The *early* downsample depth pass is the first hierarchical Z-buffer stage,
which runs after the early prepass and before the late prepass. It prepares
the Z-buffer for the bounding box tests that the late mesh preprocessing
stage will perform.

This system won't do anything if occlusion culling isn't on.

源码文档：A rendering system that invokes a compute shader for each batch set in order
to determine where `MeshUniform`s should be placed.

This shader exists because a single batch set could contain many meshes. By
performing this on the GPU, we avoid having to traverse every visible mesh
on the CPU every frame.

源码文档：A rendering system that invokes a compute shader for each batch set in order
to generate preprocessing jobs for the subsequent mesh preprocessing shader.

This shader exists because performing the unpack operation on the CPU is
slow when there are many entities. By caching the bins on the GPU from frame
to frame, we avoid having to perform a CPU-side traversal of every mesh
instance every frame.

schedule-system-564b49aab28c4856.name: early_sweep_material_instances<bevy_pbr::pbr_material::StandardMaterial>
schedule-system-564b49aab28c4856.description: 处理当前材质类型组件的移除，只删除变化刻度未在本帧刷新的渲染实例，避免同帧把材质 A 替换为 B 时误删新记录。
schedule-system-564b49aab28c4856.display_summary: 按材质移除消息清扫未被本帧替换的实例。
fields:
源码文档：Removes mesh materials from [`RenderMaterialInstances`] when their
[`MeshMaterial3d`] components are removed.

This is tricky because we have to deal with the case in which a material of
type A was removed and replaced with a material of type B in the same frame
(which is actually somewhat common of an operation). In this case, even
though an entry will be present in `RemovedComponents<MeshMaterial3d<A>>`,
we must not remove the entry in `RenderMaterialInstances` which corresponds
to material B. To handle this case, we use change ticks to avoid removing
the entry if it was updated this frame.

This is the first of two sweep phases. Because this phase runs once per
material type, we need a second phase in order to guarantee that we only
bump [`RenderMaterialInstances::current_change_tick`] once.

fields:
源码文档：Removes mesh materials from [`RenderMaterialInstances`] when their
[`MeshMaterial3d`] components are removed.

This is tricky because we have to deal with the case in which a material of
type A was removed and replaced with a material of type B in the same frame
(which is actually somewhat common of an operation). In this case, even
though an entry will be present in `RemovedComponents<MeshMaterial3d<A>>`,
we must not remove the entry in `RenderMaterialInstances` which corresponds
to material B. To handle this case, we use change ticks to avoid removing
the entry if it was updated this frame.

This is the first of two sweep phases. Because this phase runs once per
material type, we need a second phase in order to guarantee that we only
bump [`RenderMaterialInstances::current_change_tick`] once.

fields:
源码文档：A system that sets the [`RenderMeshInstanceFlags`] for each mesh based on
whether the previous frame had skins and/or morph targets.

Ordinarily, [`RenderMeshInstanceFlags`] are set during the extraction phase.
However, we can't do that for the flags related to skins and morph targets
because the previous frame's skin and morph targets are the responsibility
of [`extract_skins`] and [`extract_morphs`] respectively. We want to run
those systems in parallel with mesh extraction for performance, so we need
to defer setting of these mesh instance flags to after extraction, which
this system does. An alternative to having skin- and morph-target-related
data in [`RenderMeshInstanceFlags`] would be to have
[`crate::material::queue_material_meshes`] check the skin and morph target
tables for each mesh, but that would be too slow in the hot mesh queuing
loop.

schedule-system-2034fff83ea734fc.description: 为有相机输出或需要首次呈现的窗口取得交换链纹理，保留可复用的未呈现帧，并处理尺寸、模式变化及表面获取错误。

fields:
源码文档：(re)configures window surfaces, and obtains a swapchain texture for rendering.

NOTE: `get_current_texture` in `prepare_windows` can take a long time if the GPU workload is
the performance bottleneck. This can be seen in profiles as multiple prepare-set systems all
taking an unusually long time to complete, and all finishing at about the same time as the
`prepare_windows` system. Improvements in bevy are planned to avoid this happening when it
should not but it will still happen as it is easy for a user to create a large GPU workload
relative to the GPU performance and/or CPU workload.
This can be caused by many reasons, but several of them are:
- GPU workload is more than your current GPU can manage
- Error / performance bug in your custom shaders
- wgpu was unable to detect a proper GPU hardware-accelerated device given the chosen
  [`Backends`](crate::settings::Backends), [`WgpuLimits`](crate::settings::WgpuLimits),
  and/or [`WgpuFeatures`](crate::settings::WgpuFeatures). For example, on Windows currently
  `DirectX 11` is not supported by wgpu 0.12 and so if your GPU/drivers do not support Vulkan,
  it may be that a software renderer called "Microsoft Basic Render Driver" using `DirectX 12`
  will be chosen and performance will be very poor. This is visible in a log message that is
  output during renderer initialization.
  Another alternative is to try to use [`ANGLE`](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu#angle) and
  [`Backends::GL`](crate::settings::Backends::GL) with the `gles` feature enabled if your
  GPU/drivers support `OpenGL 4.3` / `OpenGL ES 3.0` or later.

filters:
fn collect_buffers_for_phase<PI, GFBD>(
    mut phase_batched_instance_buffers: ResMut<PhaseBatchedInstanceBuffers<PI, GFBD::BufferData>>,
    mut phase_indirect_parameters_buffers: ResMut<PhaseIndirectParametersBuffers<PI>>,
    mut batched_instance_buffers: ResMut<
        BatchedInstanceBuffers<GFBD::BufferData, GFBD::BufferInputData>,
    >,
    mut indirect_parameters_buffers: ResMut<IndirectParametersBuffers>,
    indirect_parameters_buffers_settings: Res<IndirectParametersBuffersSettings>,
) where
    PI: PhaseItem,
    GFBD: GetFullBatchData + Send + Sync + 'static,
fields:
源码文档：A system that gathers up the per-phase GPU buffers and inserts them into the
[`BatchedInstanceBuffers`] and [`IndirectParametersBuffers`] tables.

This runs after the [`batch_and_prepare_binned_render_phase`] or
[`batch_and_prepare_sorted_render_phase`] systems. It takes the per-phase
[`PhaseBatchedInstanceBuffers`] and [`PhaseIndirectParametersBuffers`]
resources and inserts them into the global [`BatchedInstanceBuffers`] and
[`IndirectParametersBuffers`] tables.

This system exists so that the [`batch_and_prepare_binned_render_phase`] and
[`batch_and_prepare_sorted_render_phase`] can run in parallel with one
another. If those two systems manipulated [`BatchedInstanceBuffers`] and
[`IndirectParametersBuffers`] directly, then they wouldn't be able to run in
parallel.

This runs as early in the pipeline as possible so that sparse buffers can be

fields:
源码文档：The default entry point for camera driven rendering added to the root [`bevy_render::renderer::RenderGraph`]
schedule. This system iterates over all cameras in the world, executing their associated
rendering schedules defined by the [`bevy_render::camera::CameraRenderGraph`] component.

After executing all camera schedules, it submits any pending command buffers to the GPU
and clears any swap chains that were not covered by a camera. Users can order any additional
operations (e.g. one-off compute passes) before or after this system in the root render
graph schedule.

components.name: Name

components.name: CharacterIntent
fields: movement: Vec2
jump_pending: bool
interact_pending: bool
components.description: 持续移动轴与一次性跳跃、交互请求跨帧保存。固定步消费布尔请求。
components.display_summary: 保存持续移动方向与单次跳跃、交互请求。

components.name: CharacterMotion
fields: grounded: bool

components.display_summary: 保存角色接地等运动观察结果。

components.name: Transform
fields: translation: Vec3
rotation: Quat
scale: Vec3
components.description: Avian 固定步回写与渲染帧插值的呈现姿态；物理位置来源是 Position，非持握系统直接搬动。

components.name: GlobalTransform
fields: 世界变换: Affine3A
components.description: 由 Transform 要求并由引擎同步；供层级传播与渲染使用。
components.display_summary: 保存层级传播后的世界姿态。

components.name: Visibility
fields: 可见性枚举
components.description: 根实体的可见性，视觉子实体继承层级可见性。

components.name: Children
fields: 子实体集合: Vec<Entity>
components.description: ChildOf 的自动反向索引，当前关联主角 GLB 视觉根；网格、骨骼与动画播放器再组成模型子树。

components.name: HoldingItems
fields: items: Vec<Entity>

fields: Dynamic

components.name: Position
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际物理位置；Forces.position()、接地与拾取读取此值。

components.name: Rotation
fields: 0: Quat

components.name: LinearVelocity
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际线速度，由冲量、外力、重力与接触求解改变。

components.name: AngularVelocity
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际角速度；释放箱体保留原有动量。
components.display_summary: 保存物理模拟中的角速度。

components.name: Mass
components.description: 显式质量，Avian 更新计算质量。
components.display_summary: 保存显式配置的质量。

components.name: ComputedMass
fields: 质量与逆质量（引擎计算）
components.description: Forces 及跳跃冲量读取的计算质量。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算质量。

components.name: ComputedAngularInertia
components.description: Avian 计算角惯量，Forces QueryData 只读。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算角惯量。

components.name: ComputedCenterOfMass
components.description: Avian 计算质量中心，Forces QueryData 只读。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算质心。

components.name: CollisionLayers
fields: membership=Character; filters=ALL
components.description: 人物保留 Character → ALL；持物与人物内部按同一 ColliderOf.body 排除，外部 Character 仍受完整阻挡。
components.display_summary: 配置实体之间允许发生碰撞的层。

components.name: CollisionEventsEnabled
components.description: 请求离散接触开始/结束消息，用于集中日志。

components.name: SweptCcd
fields: mode: SweepMode = NonLinear
filter: CcdFilter = ALL（项目显式配置）
threshold: f32 = 0.5（每步运动 / 最小 CCD 厚度比例）
components.description: 按身体最薄尺寸的半厚度门槛自动启用非线性扫掠；显式包含动态、运动学、静态和独立碰撞体，避免只采用新版默认静态/运动学过滤。
components.display_summary: 启用连续碰撞检测以减少高速穿透。

components.name: Friction
fields: 系数=0；Min 合并规则
components.description: 控制接触摩擦；人物低摩擦避免贴墙卡住。
components.display_summary: 保存接触表面的摩擦参数。

components.name: Restitution
fields: 系数=0
components.description: 接触恢复系数。

components.name: VelocityIntegrationData
components.description: Avian 内部组件；Forces 在此累计本步世界加速度/力数据，物理步消费。
components.display_summary: 累计本物理步的世界加速度与外力。

components.name: AccumulatedLocalAcceleration
components.description: Avian 内部局部加速度累计；Forces QueryData 声明可变访问，项目未用局部力方法。
components.display_summary: 累计本物理步的局部加速度。

components.name: SleepTimer
components.description: 可选 Avian 睡眠状态计时；Forces 施力/冲量可能唤醒。
components.display_summary: 记录刚体休眠计时。

components.name: TranslationInterpolation
components.description: 只对渲染帧平移执行插值，不反馈物理 Position。
components.display_summary: 启用平移显示插值。

components.name: TranslationEasingState
fields: start / end: Option<Vec3>
components.description: 固定步起止平移的插值端点，渲染帧按 overstep 混合。
components.display_summary: 保存固定步平移插值的起止端点。

components.name: LockedAxes
fields: ROTATION_LOCKED
components.description: 锁定刚体旋转防止倾倒；视角仍设置水平呈现朝向。
components.display_summary: 限制刚体可移动或旋转的轴。

components.name: ColliderAabb
fields: min / max：世界 AABB
components.description: Avian 从业务根碰撞体/刚体初始化的物理查询数据；SpatialQuery 只读。
components.display_summary: 保存碰撞查询使用的轴对齐包围盒。

components.name: SpawnPoint
fields: pose: Transform
components.description: 每个业务根独立保存出生姿态。

components.name: ResumeInterpolation
fields: translation: bool
rotation: bool
components.description: 记录本次恢复临时添加的暂停项。

components.name: NoTranslationEasing
components.description: 恢复后临时暂停；不移除原先暂停。
components.display_summary: 暂停独立平移插值。

components.name: NoRotationEasing
components.description: 恢复后临时暂停；下一固定步按归属清理。
components.display_summary: 暂停独立旋转插值。

components.name: DespawnOnExit
fields: AppState::InGame
components.description: 状态退出销毁此根；内置 ChildOf 子树随根清理。
components.display_summary: 标记退出所属应用状态时销毁此实体。

components.name: CarryBaseMass
fields: mass: f32（原质量）
components.description: 挂接时保存，释放或箱体销毁时恢复原人物质量。

components.name: RigidBodyColliders
fields: 所属碰撞 Entity 集合
components.description: Avian ColliderOf 反向关系，含人物身体与持物代理；linked_spawn 只清理代理。
components.display_summary: 索引属于同一刚体的全部碰撞体。

components.name: SpeculativeCcd
fields: max_distance: f32 = f32::MAX（default）
components.description: 显式启用随速度扩张的预测邻域；与动态扫掠配合，让相向高速物体在交会前互为候选。持物代理读取其所属人物刚体的配置。

components.name: BodySizeMetrics
fields: ccd_thickness: f32
sweep_radius: f32
components.description: RigidBody 所需组件；Avian 汇总该刚体全部碰撞体的最小 CCD 厚度和至质心的最大扫掠半径，用于尺寸比例门槛。

components.name: SolverBodyIndex
components.description: Avian 活动动态刚体在 SolverBodies 中的索引；休眠或移除刚体时删除，唤醒时由框架重新插入。该组件具有明确的可选生命周期。

components.name: Sleeping
components.description: 可选休眠标记；外部变化触发提前 WakeBody，未变化时继续休眠。

components.name: Name
fields: 名称: String
components.description: 木箱快递根实体名称。

components.name: Parcel
components.description: 快递身份标记。

components.name: Pickable
components.description: 可拾取能力标记；交互系统按此能力选择物体。
components.display_summary: 标记可被玩家拾取的物品。

components.name: Transform
fields: translation: Vec3
rotation: Quat
scale: Vec3
components.description: 自由时为物理插值呈现，持握时由 carry 系统按同一局部挂接姿态直接派生箱根呈现。
components.display_summary: 保存自由运动或共享持握时的显示姿态。

components.name: GlobalTransform
fields: 世界变换: Affine3A
components.description: 由 Transform 要求并由引擎同步，用于木箱模型层级传播。
components.display_summary: 保存层级传播后的世界姿态。

components.name: Visibility
fields: 可见性枚举
components.description: 根实体可见性。

components.name: Children
fields: 子实体集合: Vec<Entity>
components.description: 模型视觉根与导入 GLB 子树，持握不改变箱体视觉树归属。
components.display_summary: 索引当前实体的直接子实体。

components.name: HeldBy
fields: holder: Entity
components.description: 可选关系组件，仅持有时存在；指向持有者，增删通过 Commands 延迟执行。
components.display_summary: 关联当前物品的持有者。

components.name: RigidBody
fields: Dynamic（自由时）；持握时移除
components.description: 仅自由或释放后恢复独立 Dynamic；持握期间移除，人物是组合体唯一 Dynamic。
components.display_summary: 定义实体参与物理模拟的刚体模式。

components.name: Collider
fields: 纸箱 cuboid：边长 0.6
components.description: 业务根碰撞体，视觉子实体不添加物理体。
components.display_summary: 保存参与物理碰撞的实体形状。

components.name: Position
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际物理位置；Forces.position()、接地与拾取读取此值。
components.display_summary: 保存物理模拟中的真实位置。

components.name: Rotation
fields: 0: Quat
components.description: 实际物理旋转；角色锁旋转，箱体允许旋转。
components.display_summary: 保存物理模拟中的真实旋转。

components.name: LinearVelocity
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际线速度，由冲量、外力、重力与接触求解改变。

components.name: AngularVelocity
fields: 0: Vec3
components.description: 实际角速度；释放箱体保留原有动量。
components.display_summary: 保存物理模拟中的角速度。

components.name: Mass
components.description: 显式质量，Avian 更新计算质量。
components.display_summary: 保存显式配置的质量。

components.name: ComputedMass
fields: 质量与逆质量（引擎计算）
components.description: Forces 及跳跃冲量读取的计算质量。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算质量。

components.name: ComputedAngularInertia
components.description: Avian 计算角惯量，Forces QueryData 只读。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算角惯量。

components.name: ComputedCenterOfMass
components.description: Avian 计算质量中心，Forces QueryData 只读。
components.display_summary: 保存物理求解使用的计算质心。

components.name: CollisionLayers
fields: 自由及持物代理：Parcel → ALL
components.description: 同一组合体内部依赖共享刚体排除，外部 World / NPC / Character / Parcel 保留完整碰撞。
components.display_summary: 配置实体之间允许发生碰撞的层。

components.name: CollisionEventsEnabled
components.description: 请求离散接触开始/结束消息，用于集中日志。

components.name: SweptCcd
fields: mode: SweepMode = NonLinear
filter: CcdFilter = ALL（项目显式配置）
threshold: f32 = 0.5（每步运动 / 最小 CCD 厚度比例）
components.description: 按身体最薄尺寸的半厚度门槛自动启用非线性扫掠；显式包含动态、运动学、静态和独立碰撞体，避免只采用新版默认静态/运动学过滤。

components.name: Friction
components.description: 控制接触摩擦；人物低摩擦避免贴墙卡住。
components.display_summary: 保存接触表面的摩擦参数。

components.name: Restitution
components.description: 接触恢复系数。

components.name: VelocityIntegrationData
components.description: Avian 内部组件；Forces 在此累计本步世界加速度/力数据，物理步消费。
components.display_summary: 累计本物理步的世界加速度与外力。

components.name: AccumulatedLocalAcceleration
components.description: Avian 内部局部加速度累计；Forces QueryData 声明可变访问，项目未用局部力方法。
components.display_summary: 累计本物理步的局部加速度。

components.name: SleepTimer
components.description: 可选 Avian 睡眠状态计时；Forces 施力/冲量可能唤醒。
components.display_summary: 记录刚体休眠计时。

components.name: TranslationInterpolation
components.description: 只对渲染帧平移执行插值，不反馈物理 Position。
components.display_summary: 启用平移显示插值。

components.name: TranslationEasingState
fields: start / end: Option<Vec3>
components.description: 固定步起止平移的插值端点，渲染帧按 overstep 混合。
components.display_summary: 保存固定步平移插值的起止端点。

components.name: LockedAxes
components.description: Forces 的可选只读组件；当前箱体不锁旋转。
components.display_summary: 限制刚体可移动或旋转的轴。

components.name: AngularDamping
components.description: 物理角速度阻尼。

components.name: NoRotationEasing

components.name: HeldAttachment
fields: collider: Entity
local_pose: Transform
pending: bool
free_body: RigidBody
translation_was_paused / rotation_was_paused / collider_was_disabled: bool
blocked_seconds: f32
components.description: 持握期间真实箱体局部姿态与装卸生命周期唯一数据源；业务根仍独立。

components.name: ResumeCarryEasing
fields: translation: bool
rotation: bool

components.name: ColliderDisabled
components.description: 持握期间停用原箱根碰撞；真实形状复制到人物所属代理，避免第二次碰撞。

components.name: ColliderOf

components.description: Avian 自动维护碰撞归属；拾取移除独立刚体后卸载原归属，释放辅助函数再次移除残留，真实业务箱不关联人物的 linked_spawn。
components.display_summary: 关联碰撞体所属的刚体。

components.name: Sleeping
components.description: 可选休眠状态；释放时移除，确保恢复的自由刚体可以继续运动。

components.name: SpeculativeCcd
fields: max_distance: f32 = f32::MAX（default）
components.description: 显式启用随速度扩张的预测邻域；与动态扫掠配合，让相向高速物体在交会前互为候选。持物代理读取其所属人物刚体的配置。

components.name: BodySizeMetrics
fields: ccd_thickness: f32
sweep_radius: f32
components.description: RigidBody 所需组件；Avian 汇总该刚体全部碰撞体的最小 CCD 厚度和至质心的最大扫掠半径，用于尺寸比例门槛。

components.name: SolverBodyIndex
components.description: Avian 活动动态刚体在 SolverBodies 中的索引；休眠或移除刚体时删除，唤醒时由框架重新插入。该组件具有明确的可选生命周期。

entity-camera.description: 与控制者和角色通过普通 Entity 引用关联；观察水平角驱动角色朝向，俯仰只作用于镜头。加载时带 LoadingCamera，地图准备后复用同一实体，替换为 FirstPersonCamera 与 MouseLookState。
entity-camera.display_summary: 提供跟随角色的第一人称视角与观察输入状态。

components.name: Name
fields: 名称: String
components.description: 相机名称。

components.name: Camera3d
fields: 三维相机设置
components.description: 引擎三维相机组件；其要求的渲染组件在此清单中省略。
components.display_summary: 标记三维场景相机。

components.name: FirstPersonCamera
fields: target: Entity
yaw: f32
pending_yaw_delta: f32（完整有符号待消费水平转角）
pitch: f32
eye_height: f32
components.description: 第一人称目标与观察状态；默认水平角和俯仰为 0°，俯仰限制 -85°..85°，眼位在角色脚底上方 1.65 m；实际姿态由 Transform 保存。pending_yaw_delta 使用 reflect(ignore)，留给朝向系统消费完整转角。
components.display_summary: 保存跟随目标、眼高与观察角度。

components.name: MouseLookState
fields: active: bool
initialized: bool
skip_motion: bool
target_available: bool
components.description: 保存捕获、初始化、跳过位移与目标可用状态。F3 在游戏控制和检查器操作之间切换；主菜单、暂停及失焦释放光标，检查器模式停用整个 GameplayContext。
components.display_summary: 保存光标捕获与观察输入初始化状态。

components.name: Transform
fields: translation: Vec3
rotation: Quat
scale: Vec3
components.description: follow_first_person_camera 按角色本帧呈现位置、眼高、水平角和俯仰计算第一人称姿态。
components.display_summary: 保存第一人称镜头的显示姿态。

components.name: GlobalTransform
fields: 世界变换: Affine3A
components.description: 引擎传播后的相机世界变换，供渲染提取。

components.name: EguiContext
fields: ctx: egui::Context
components.description: PrimaryEguiContext 要求的共享 UI 状态，由检查器界面计算与反射面板使用；捕获系统通过 EguiContextSettings 控制输入转发，不读取面板命中或文本焦点。
components.display_summary: 保存世界检查器的界面交互状态。

components.name: PrimaryEguiContext
components.description: 场景显式标记玩法相机；主菜单退出时展示相机已清理，设置与暂停继续复用当前相机。
components.display_summary: 指定主检查器界面的相机上下文。

components.name: EguiContextSettings
fields: run_manually: bool = false
input_system_settings: EguiInputSystemSettings
enable_cursor_icon_updates: bool
enable_ime: bool
components.description: EguiContext 要求的组件；捕获系统按模式切换主上下文的指针、滚轮、键盘与输入法转发。
components.display_summary: 配置检查器上下文的输入与输出处理。

components.name: EguiInput
fields: 0: egui::RawInput
components.description: 检查器的 RawInput 缓冲；引擎按上下文转发配置写入，项目仅在恢复捕获时追加 PointerGone 清除遗留悬停。
components.display_summary: 缓冲检查器界面收到的输入。

components.name: EguiSchedule
fields: 0: InternedScheduleLabel = EguiPrimaryContextPass
components.description: PrimaryEguiContext 要求此组件，默认指向 EguiPrimaryContextPass；PostUpdate 的上下文循环据此调用内部 UI Schedule，可在一帧执行多轮。旧投影 ID 保留以兼容已有链接，真实类型定义为 EguiSchedule。
components.display_summary: 指定检查器上下文的内部界面调度。

components.name: EguiFullOutput
fields: 0: Option<egui::FullOutput>
components.description: UI 计算输出，由多轮上下文循环写入并交给插件输出、渲染处理。
components.display_summary: 保存检查器界面计算产生的输出。

components.name: LoadingCamera
components.description: 加载期间相机身份，准备后移除。

components.name: DespawnOnExit
fields: AppState::InGame
components.description: 状态退出销毁此根；内置 ChildOf 子树随根清理。
components.display_summary: 标记退出所属应用状态时销毁此实体。

components.name: IsDefaultUiCamera
components.description: 游戏会话中的 Bevy UI 默认相机。
components.display_summary: 指定菜单界面的默认绘制相机。

fields: 可见性枚举

sole_markers: [Entity; 8]

offset: f32

entity-action.name: 动作实体
entity-action.description: GameplayContext 的四个动作实体：Look、Move、Jump、Interact。MenuContext 独立拥有六个菜单动作，未混入该类别。InputAction 标记不是组件，组件为 Action<A>。

components.name: Name
fields: 名称: String
components.description: Action<A> 要求的动作名称，用于插件诊断。

components.name: Action<LookAction>
fields: 输出: Vec2
components.description: LookAction 动作实体上的具体 Action 泛型组件，由 Enhanced Input 的 Apply 阶段写入当前输出。
components.display_summary: 保存LookAction动作的当前输出。

components.name: Action<MoveAction>
fields: 输出: Vec2
components.description: MoveAction 动作实体上的具体 Action 泛型组件，由 Enhanced Input 的 Apply 阶段写入当前输出。
components.display_summary: 保存MoveAction动作的当前输出。

components.name: Action<JumpAction>
fields: 输出: bool
components.description: JumpAction 动作实体上的具体 Action 泛型组件，由 Enhanced Input 的 Apply 阶段写入当前输出。
components.display_summary: 保存JumpAction动作的当前输出。

components.name: Action<InteractAction>
fields: 输出: bool
components.description: InteractAction 动作实体上的具体 Action 泛型组件，由 Enhanced Input 的 Apply 阶段写入当前输出。
components.display_summary: 保存InteractAction动作的当前输出。

components.name: ActionSettings
fields: accumulation: Accumulation
require_reset: bool
consume_input: bool
components.description: 四个玩法动作 consume_input=true；Jump、Interact 使用 require_reset=true，其余保持默认。消费只影响动作评估。
components.display_summary: 保存动作的输入消费与重新激活策略。

components.name: ActionOf<GameplayContext>
fields: 上下文实体: Entity
components.description: 动作到控制者上下文的关系；BSN Actions<GameplayContext> 建立关系，Actions<GameplayContext> 为自动反向索引。
components.display_summary: 将动作关联到所属控制上下文。

components.name: Bindings
fields: 绑定实体集合: Vec<Entity>
components.description: BindingOf 自动反向索引；MoveAction 四条，其余三个 GameplayContext 动作各一条。
components.display_summary: 索引动作拥有的输入绑定。

components.name: Press
fields: actuation: f32
actuated: bool（内部状态）
components.description: JumpAction 与 InteractAction 使用 Press；每次按下触发一次，按住不重复。
components.display_summary: 将按钮按下转换为一次触发。

components.name: ActionValue
fields: Bool / Axis1D / Axis2D / Axis3D
components.description: 动作评估产生的类型擦除输出；当前使用 Bool 与 Axis2D。
components.display_summary: 保存动作评估产生的通用输入值。

components.name: TriggerState
fields: None / Ongoing / Fired
components.description: 动作本次评估状态；由插件维护。
components.display_summary: 保存本次动作评估的触发状态。

components.name: ActionEvents
fields: 事件状态位: u8
components.description: 决定本次 Apply 需要排入哪些动作事件；不是 Message 队列。
components.display_summary: 保存本次待派发的动作事件。

components.name: ActionTime
fields: elapsed_secs: f32
fired_secs: f32
components.description: 动作持续与触发计时，由插件评估更新。

components.name: ActionMock
fields: state: TriggerState
value: ActionValue
span: MockSpan
enabled: bool
components.description: Action<A> 要求的模拟输入状态，正常游戏默认禁用；测试可使用。
components.display_summary: 保存测试使用的模拟动作输入。

components.name: ActionFns
fields: 写入具体输出与触发具体事件的函数表
components.description: Action<A> 要求的类型擦除适配，Apply 阶段将 ActionValue 写入具体组件并排入事件。
components.display_summary: 将通用动作值适配为具体动作组件。

components.name: ConditionFns
fields: 输入条件评估函数表
components.description: 两个带 Press 的玩法动作具有此适配；插件访问并更新条件。
components.display_summary: 保存动作触发条件的执行适配。

components.name: MenuButton
fields: action: UiAction
index: usize
components.description: 业务动作与连续导航序号，不依赖按钮文字或实体名。
components.display_summary: 保存菜单动作及按钮的导航序号。

components.name: VolumeSlider
fields: key: SettingKey
components.description: Audio 页滑条仍为普通 MenuButton，左右步进与鼠标坐标共用字段键。
components.display_summary: 标识滑条编辑的音量设置项。

components.name: Button
components.description: 原生无样式按钮；ButtonPlugin 维护 Pressed 并发 Activate，项目仅消费 Primary PointerPress，不消费键盘 Activate。
components.display_summary: 启用原生界面按钮命中处理。

components.name: Node
fields: 尺寸/间距/边框/折行
components.description: BSN 控件布局；文字叶节点保留自然宽度。
components.display_summary: 保存界面节点的布局约束。

components.name: BackgroundColor
fields: PAPER / GOLD / pressed
components.description: style_buttons 按输入来源、Hovered 与 Pressed / PrimaryPress 状态更新。
components.display_summary: 保存界面节点的背景颜色。

components.name: BorderColor
fields: CREAM / INK
components.description: 悬停/键盘焦点时使用深色边框。
components.display_summary: 保存界面节点的边框颜色。

components.name: SettingDescription
fields: title: &str
body: &str
components.description: 实际设置的箭头携带说明；焦点更新右侧文本，不重建页面。
components.display_summary: 关联当前设置项的说明文字。

components.name: ComputedNode
fields: size / content_size
components.description: 原生布局后的按钮几何，用于焦点滚入。

components.name: UiGlobalTransform
fields: affine: Affine2
components.description: 与视口坐标比较按钮上下边界。
components.display_summary: 保存按钮在界面中的全局变换。

components.name: ChildOf
fields: parent: Entity
components.description: 按钮通过 BSN 布局层归属页面；焦点滚入沿父级查找设置视口，不能把间接归属画成直属页面关系。
components.display_summary: 关联父实体并跟随父级生命周期。

components.name: Hovered
fields: 0: bool（不可变组件，通过替换更新）
components.description: 原生 Picking 的祖先悬停状态；MenuButton 的 required component。
components.display_summary: 保存按钮或其子树是否被悬停。

components.name: Pressed
components.description: 原生 Button 按任意指针键插入，释放、拖动结束、取消时移除；项目取消回退也能移除。按下颜色还要求 PrimaryPress。
components.display_summary: 标记原生按钮当前被按压。

components.name: PrimaryPress
fields: pointer: PointerId
components.description: 菜单主键按下的指针身份；主键 PointerPress Observer 插入，Pressed 移除及取消/窗口生命周期清理时删除。
components.display_summary: 区分菜单主键按压与其他按钮来源。

app-main.name: main / App
app-main.description: 解析启动方式后创建 App 与会话日志，配置默认插件、加载设置并装配功能插件；正常启动进入游戏循环，debugdump 模式在插件就绪和 finish 后导出已注册调度并返回。两种模式均记录退出结果并刷新日志。
app-main.display_summary: 装配应用、执行游戏或调度导出并管理退出。
notes: main 创建 App 与独立会话日志；DefaultPlugins 禁用 Bevy 默认 AudioPlugin，由 Kira 提供音频设备输出。
InspectorPlugin 内部先注册 EguiPlugin，再注册 WorldInspectorPlugin；检查器只在 InGame / Running 显示。功能插件装配顺序不等于系统全序。
GameFlowPlugin 默认进入 MainMenu；当前 State<PlayState> 只在 InGame 存在，NextState<PlayState> 从插件注册起跨会话保留。Startup 创建持久 MenuContext 控制者、预加载短音并记录启动日志；美术请求由 ArtAssets::from_world 在资源初始化时逐份记录。
SceneAssemblyPlugin 保持五份运行 GLB 强句柄，Update 轮询 Loading / Ready / Failed；地图 CPU 网格保留以生成静态碰撞。
OnEnter(InGame) 创建日光和加载相机。Running 的 Update 海岛链 begin_island → prepare_island → spawn_actors 在各依赖处应用延迟命令。
海岛资源与全部静态碰撞就绪后生成一名主角、一名控制者、普通纸箱与易碎纸箱各一件及三只木箱，并复用加载相机。NPC 沿原地图层级保留。
Pause 清空玩法意图、停用上下文、释放光标并冻结虚拟与物理时间，保留全部会话实体；返回 MainMenu 用 DespawnOnExit(InGame) / ChildOf 清理。
菜单相机与独立 GLB 展示舞台属于 MainMenu；退出主菜单后销毁，由玩法相机接管 UI 与 Egui 上下文。
主角 WorldInstanceReady 添加 pending；Update initialize_ready_couriers → sync_courier_animation 读取真实速度与持有关系，仅在 Running 绑定 16 个命名片段并连续混合。
主菜单模板就绪只标记菜单 pending；Update 按 Carry_Idle 名称等待片段，不依赖 GLTF 动作排序。
BSN 与 Bundle 辅助数据、MapAsset / ItemPlacement、动画节点和 QueryData 不作为独立玩法 ECS 组件列出。
统一 tracing 的文件与控制台各有后台线程和无界队列，属于外部 I/O；SessionLogGuard 由 main 持有，退出 Flush，Drop 排空并 join，panic 文件屏障 sync_data。
GameAudioPlugin 初始化 AudioMix；UI 注册滑条采样与已有视觉同步，设置草稿可即时预览音量。
FirstPersonPlugin 注册观察 Observer、F3 捕获切换及第一人称显示链；相机引用角色，CharacterVisual 初始隐藏并在关联失效时恢复。
玩法配置、固定时间步和检查器启用三项只读 Startup 日志分别由对应功能插件注册，彼此无显式顺序。
主入口显式安装十四个功能插件和 EnhancedInputPlugin；CharacterPlugin 不自动安装物理、交互或音频。
SessionLogPlugin 在 DefaultPlugins 之前安装真实 LogPlugin；主入口守卫持有文件与控制台线程直到退出刷新完成。
GameFlowPlugin 通过 FixedGameplaySystems、PresentationSystems 和音频阶段建立跨功能顺序；无状态测试可单独调用 configure_feature_order。

capture-state.name: 捕获与输入上下文
capture-state.description: 相机与窗口保存捕获状态；F3 切换模式，直接配置主 Egui 输入转发，并通过 Commands 替换 GameplayContext 的 ContextActivity。
capture-state.display_summary: 保存光标捕获与玩法输入启用状态。
notes: 显式 after(InputSystems)、after(EguiPreUpdateSet::InitContexts)、before(EguiPreUpdateSet::ProcessInput) 与 before(EnhancedInputSystems::Prepare)。
F3 独立于 GameplayContext 切换游戏与检查器输入归属；检查器两种模式下均可显示，点击面板内外不切换模式。
CursorOptions、MouseLookState、EguiContextSettings 与 EguiInput 直接修改；ContextActivity 是不可变组件，通过 Commands 替换，并在动作 Prepare 前应用。
捕获时关闭主 Egui 上下文的指针、滚轮、键盘与输入法转发；恢复捕获时追加 PointerGone 清除遗留悬停，不终止拖拽或文本编辑。切换前须结束其他输入手势。
失焦、菜单、暂停或控制关联失效释放捕获并停用玩法上下文；回焦后由 F3 恢复，从暂停恢复则重新初始化捕获。Esc 暂停由菜单动作处理，底层 Esc 只释放光标。
停用上下文不清空 ButtonInput；动作完成或取消清除持续移动轴，重新启用仍遵循 require_reset。

ecs-component-lifecycle.name: 组件移除与实体销毁流程
ecs-component-lifecycle.description: Bevy World 在组件实际移除或实体实际销毁期间，按原型组件集合匹配并触发生命周期 Observer。
ecs-component-lifecycle.display_summary: 在实际移除或销毁时发出匹配的生命周期事件。
notes: 这是 World 内部生命周期流程，不是独立注册系统，也没有固定 Schedule。
Commands 的移除与销毁要等命令应用；直接 World 操作在操作过程中触发。
实体销毁会派发 DespawnEvent，并为其组件派发 RemoveEvent；匹配组件仍由各 Observer 的 EventPattern 限定。
人物与 GameplayContext 控制者退出 InGame 的生产清理由 DespawnOnExit<AppState> 驱动。

schedule-set-029cbea75ba0988c.name: PhysicsSystems::First
schedule-set-029cbea75ba0988c.description: 允许项目或扩展逻辑排在物理功能之前，本快照关联数值断言与修改后刚体唤醒；原生该边界默认不放置成员。
schedule-set-029cbea75ba0988c.display_summary: 在所有 Avian 物理系统之前提供准备边界。
fields:
集合类型源码文档：High-level system sets for the main phases of the physics engine.
You can use these to schedule your own systems before or after physics is run without
having to worry about implementation details.

1. `First`: Runs right before any of Avian's physics systems. Empty by default.
2. `Prepare`: Responsible for preparing data for the physics simulation, such as updating
   physics transforms or mass properties.
3. `StepSimulation`: Responsible for advancing the simulation by running the steps in [`PhysicsStepSystems`].
4. `Writeback`: Responsible for writing back the results of the physics simulation to other data,
   such as updating [`Transform`] based on the new [`Position`] and [`Rotation`].
5. `Last`: Runs right after all of Avian's physics systems. Empty by default.

# See Also

- [`PhysicsSchedule`]: Responsible for advancing the simulation in [`PhysicsSystems::StepSimulation`].
- [`PhysicsStepSystems`]: System sets for the steps of the actual physics simulation loop, like
  the broad phase and the substepping loop.
- [`SubstepSchedule`]: Responsible for running the substepping loop in [`PhysicsStepSystems::Solver`].

fields:
集合类型源码文档：System sets for the constraint solver.

# Steps

Below is the core solver loop.

1. Prepare solver bodies ([`SolverSystems::PrepareSolverBodies`])
2. Prepare joints ([`SolverSystems::PrepareJoints`])
3. Prepare contact constraints ([`SolverSystems::PrepareContactConstraints`])
4. Substepping loop (runs the [`SubstepSchedule`] [`SubstepCount`] times; see [`SolverSystems::Substep`])
5. Apply restitution ([`SolverSystems::Restitution`])
6. Perform Continuous Collision Detection (CCD) for fast dynamic bodies ([`SolverSystems::ContinuousCollision`])
7. Write back solver body data to rigid bodies. ([`SolverSystems::Finalize`])
8. Store contact impulses for next frame's warm starting ([`SolverSystems::StoreContactImpulses`])

fields:
集合类型源码文档：Set enum for the systems that want to run inside [`RunFixedMainLoop`],
but before or after the fixed update logic. Systems in this set
will run exactly once per frame, regardless of the number of fixed updates.
They will also run under a variable timestep.

This is useful for handling things that need to run every frame, but
also need to be read by the fixed update logic. See the individual variants
for examples of what kind of systems should be placed in each.

Note that in contrast to most other Bevy schedules, systems added directly to
[`RunFixedMainLoop`] will *not* be parallelized between each other.

schedule-set-bbe05c290a99b68d.name: RunFixedMainLoopSystems::FixedMainLoop
schedule-set-bbe05c290a99b68d.description: 以 Time<Virtual> 的累计时间和 overstep 控制 FixedMain 循环；业务系统通常注册到 FixedUpdate 等子调度，此集合主要提供相对固定循环的排序边界。
schedule-set-bbe05c290a99b68d.display_summary: 根据虚拟时间推进零次或多次固定更新。
fields:
集合类型源码文档：Set enum for the systems that want to run inside [`RunFixedMainLoop`],
but before or after the fixed update logic. Systems in this set
will run exactly once per frame, regardless of the number of fixed updates.
They will also run under a variable timestep.

This is useful for handling things that need to run every frame, but
also need to be read by the fixed update logic. See the individual variants
for examples of what kind of systems should be placed in each.

Note that in contrast to most other Bevy schedules, systems added directly to
[`RunFixedMainLoop`] will *not* be parallelized between each other.

schedule-set-83e7d346f4ee37ca.name: SubstepSolverSystems::WarmStart
schedule-set-83e7d346f4ee37ca.description: 把上一帧或子步保存的冲量施加到当前求解器刚体，提高约束迭代收敛速度；可能产生的过强响应由 Relax 阶段放松。
schedule-set-83e7d346f4ee37ca.display_summary: 以历史接触冲量热启动求解器。
fields:
集合类型源码文档：System sets for the substepped part of the constraint solver.

# Steps

1. Integrate velocity ([`IntegrationSystems::Velocity`])
2. Warm start ([`SubstepSolverSystems::WarmStart`])
3. Solve constraints with bias ([`SubstepSolverSystems::SolveConstraints`])
4. Integrate positions ([`IntegrationSystems::Position`])
5. Solve constraints without bias to relax velocities ([`SubstepSolverSystems::Relax`])
6. Apply velocity-based constraint damping ([`SubstepSolverSystems::Damping`])

schedule-set-f95312bb9ae7a83e.name: SubstepSolverSystems::SolveConstraints
schedule-set-f95312bb9ae7a83e.description: 在子步中按约束误差加入位置偏置，迭代接触和其他速度约束以修正重叠。

fields:
集合类型源码文档：System sets for the Core 2D rendering pipeline, defining the main stages of rendering.
These stages include and run in the following order:
- `Prepass`: Initial rendering operations, such as depth pre-pass.
- `MainPass`: The primary rendering operations, including drawing 2D sprites and meshes.
- `EarlyPostProcess`: Initial post processing effects.
- `PostProcess`: Final rendering operations, such as post-processing effects.

Additional systems can be added to these sets to customize the rendering pipeline, or additional
sets can be created relative to these core sets.

schedule-access-df3674bbf15502a8.name: EguiContext
schedule-access-df3674bbf15502a8.description: 包装一个 egui::Context，保存该界面的输入处理、UI 构建和绘制状态。不同 Egui 上下文由不同实体承载。
fields: 源码文档：A component for storing `bevy_egui` context.

声明字段／枚举项：
ctx: egui::Context,
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::end_pass_system：对非手动运行的 Egui 上下文调用 end_pass，把生成的 FullOutput 保存到组件，供随后拆分平台命令、纹理增量与绘制图元。 参数范围：main；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::output::process_output_system：取走 Egui FullOutput，将形状细分为绘制图元并保存纹理增量、平台输出和像素比例；按已启用功能处理剪贴板、URL及光标更新，需要时请求重绘，缺少 pass 输出时记录错误。 参数范围：main；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::input::write_egui_wants_input_system：重置 EguiWantsInput 后遍历各上下文，合并指针悬停、指针使用、键盘输入需求及弹出层打开状态，供其他输入系统判断是否响应。 参数范围：main；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::input::process_ime_system：依据 Egui 平台输出决定原生窗口是否允许 IME，并把当前编辑矩形按 Egui 缩放换算为窗口输入法光标区域；上下文禁用 IME 或没有窗口映射时跳过。 参数范围：main；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::update_ui_screen_rect：读取相机物理视口，将其除以 Egui 像素点比例得到逻辑矩形并写入 RawInput.screen_rect；视口缺失或尺寸小于一个逻辑单位时跳过。 参数范围：main；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::setup_primary_egui_context_system：检查新相机及本系统已创建上下文的标志，尚无主上下文时向首个相机插入 EguiContext 与 PrimaryEguiContext；已有上下文或已处理过时不再创建。自动创建行为由插件配置控制。 参数范围：main；只读声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_egui::input::WindowToEguiContextMap::on_egui_context_added_system：为新上下文建立窗口到上下文及上下文到窗口的双向映射。存在 Winit 事件循环代理时还安装重绘回调，在 Egui 请求立即重绘时唤醒事件循环。 参数范围：main；可变声明。

schedule-access-2965b320a33ca329.name: World
schedule-access-2965b320a33ca329.description: 保存实体、组件、资源及关联元数据，并提供生成、查询、访问与生命周期操作。每个主应用或子应用有各自的 World。
schedule-access-2965b320a33ca329.display_summary: 保存实体、组件、资源及关联元数据
fields:
源码文档：Stores and exposes operations on [entities](Entity), [components](Component), resources,
and their associated metadata.

Each [`Entity`] has a set of unique components, based on their type.
Entity components can be created, updated, removed, and queried using a given [`World`].

For complex access patterns involving [`SystemParam`](crate::system::SystemParam),
consider using [`SystemState`](crate::system::SystemState).

To mutate different parts of the world simultaneously,
use [`World::resource_scope`] or [`SystemState`](crate::system::SystemState).

## Resources

Worlds can also store [`Resource`]s,
which are unique instances of a given type that belong to a specific unique Entity.
There are also *non send resources*, which can only be accessed on the main thread.
These are stored outside of the ECS.
See [`Resource`] for usage.
已核实使用场景：bevy_ecs::message::update::message_update_system：轮换所有已登记消息缓冲区的当前批次并清理超出保留窗口的消息，保留读者的独立读取游标。 参数范围：main；可变声明。

bevy_core_pipeline::core_2d::main_opaque_pass_2d_node::main_opaque_pass_2d：取得视图颜色与深度附件后创建二维主通道，应用相机视口，依次渲染不透明及 AlphaMask 项；阶段缺失时返回，绘制错误记录日志。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::core_2d::main_transparent_pass_2d_node::main_transparent_pass_2d：透明阶段存在且非空时创建主透明通道，沿用深度附件与相机视口绘制排序后的透明项；WebGL 自定义视口后追加空通道复位视口状态。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_ui_render::render_pass::ui_pass：找到 UI 相机对应的视图、颜色目标及透明 UI 阶段，按相机视口渲染已排队的 UI 项；视图缺失或阶段为空时不创建绘制通道。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_egui::render::render_pass::prepare_egui_pass：消费每个 Egui 视图暂缓处理的绘制回调更新，构造视口、裁剪、像素比例和目标尺寸信息，并在当前渲染世界调用回调的 update。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_egui::render::render_pass::egui_pass：读取当前 Egui 视图已准备的绘制数据、纹理绑定及变换缓冲，在目标颜色附件上执行 Egui 绘制命令，并按相机视口设置渲染范围。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::prepass::node::early_prepass：从当前视图取得深度、预通道纹理及前后帧参数，调用共享预通道实现绘制不透明和 AlphaMask 预通道阶段，供后续深度、法线及运动矢量相关处理使用。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::deferred::node::early_deferred_prepass：渲染三维不透明及 AlphaMask 延迟阶段，按已启用附件输出法线、运动矢量、G-buffer 和光照通道标识，再将视图深度复制到预通道深度纹理；缺少阶段时跳过。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::prepass::node::late_prepass：仅在遮挡剔除开启且允许间接绘制时执行晚期预通道，复用共享实现绘制对应的不透明和 AlphaMask 预通道阶段；其他视图直接跳过。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::deferred::node::late_deferred_prepass：仅在启用遮挡剔除且允许间接绘制时运行延迟阶段，写入已有预通道附件并同步深度纹理，补绘晚期可见物体；未满足条件时直接返回。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::core_3d::main_opaque_pass_3d_node::main_opaque_pass_3d：使用视图颜色和深度附件及相机视口渲染不透明和 AlphaMask 阶段，天空盒管线与绑定可用时追加全屏天空盒；阶段缺失时跳过，阶段绘制错误记录日志。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::core_3d::main_transparent_pass_3d_node::main_transparent_pass_3d：透明阶段非空时沿用视图颜色、深度及视口绘制排序项；启用顺序无关透明时须等待其解析管线就绪，避免提前写入未能清理的链表计数器。WebGL 自定义视口后复位视口状态。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::transmission::node::main_transmissive_pass_3d：按透射阶段的排序结果划分绘制范围，每步先把当前主纹理复制到透射纹理，再绘制该范围；步数为零时使用不复制纹理的单次绘制，并应用相机视口及主通道分辨率覆盖。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::render::light::per_view_shadow_pass<false>：遍历当前视图关联的阴影视图，需要时按早期或后期阶段构建间接绘制参数，再调用共享阴影绘制流程；保持 IS_LATE 两种实例各自的阶段身份。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::render::light::per_view_shadow_pass<true>：遍历当前视图关联的阴影视图，需要时按早期或后期阶段构建间接绘制参数，再调用共享阴影绘制流程；保持 IS_LATE 两种实例各自的阶段身份。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::render::light::shared_shadow_pass<false>：取得当前光源阴影视图与遮挡裁剪状态，按 IS_LATE 指定的早期或后期实例调用共享阴影绘制流程，不为每台相机重复维护独立光源阴影。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::render::light::shared_shadow_pass<true>：取得当前光源阴影视图与遮挡裁剪状态，按 IS_LATE 指定的早期或后期实例调用共享阴影绘制流程，不为每台相机重复维护独立光源阴影。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_ecs::message::update::message_update_system：轮换所有已登记消息缓冲区的当前批次并清理超出保留窗口的消息，保留读者的独立读取游标。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_extract::extract_plugin::apply_extract_commands：应用提取阶段积累的延迟命令，使渲染世界中同步的实体和组件对后续阶段可见。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_pbr::prepass::specialize_prepass_material_meshes：为变化的可见网格组合采样、预通道、光照贴图、距离渐变及前帧蒙皮形变键，选择深度专用或材质绘制函数并缓存结果；清理禁用预通道、混合透明或读取透射纹理的旧专用化。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_sprite_render::mesh2d::material::specialize_material2d_meshes：按视图和实体脏标记清除旧缓存，组合视图键、网格布局和材质属性收集专用化任务，更新材质绑定索引并生成管线缓存；网格或材质未准备时进入待处理队列，失败记录错误，最后清理失效视图缓存。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_pbr::material::specialize_material_meshes：合并视图、几何、材质、光照贴图、可见范围及前帧蒙皮形变特性构造管线键，调用材质专用化回调并按视图保存结果；清理旧缓存及失效视图，实例或材质未就绪时保留重试项。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_pbr::render::light::specialize_shadows：按阴影视图、网格及材质变化重新选择专用阴影渲染管线，清理失效缓存，并整理需要补齐或重新排队的阴影网格任务。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_render::renderer::render_system：运行根 RenderGraph 调度，提交截图及 GPU 回读收尾命令，并呈现需要输出的窗口交换链；随后收集截图结果。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_extract::sync_world::despawn_temporary_entities<bevy_render::RenderApp>：收集带当前子应用 TemporaryEntity 标记的实体，按索引排序后逆序销毁，并复用 Local 列表，使下一帧实体分配顺序保持稳定。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::schedule::camera_driver：遍历辅助根视图及已排序相机，为有效视图设置 CurrentView 并运行其专属渲染调度；跳过失效窗口目标，结束后移除 CurrentView 并记录本帧相机覆盖的窗口集合。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::schedule::submit_pending_command_buffers：从 PendingCommandBuffers 取出已完成命令缓冲，仅在迭代器非空时提交 RenderQueue；启用追踪时记录本次提交的缓冲数量。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::schedule::handle_uncovered_swap_chains：消费 CameraWindows 记录，找出没有相机输出但存在交换链纹理的窗口，用全局 ClearColor 创建清除通道并直接提交 GPU 队列，避免窗口保留旧画面。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
bevy_render::run_render_schedule：按 RenderScheduleOrder 中维护的阶段标签顺序，依次尝试运行渲染子应用的各个调度。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。

schedule-access-591e30e595b0cddd.description: 保存延迟执行的 World 操作队列，可排入生成、销毁、组件及资源操作。排队不等于即时执行，操作在 ApplyDeferred 阶段应用。

fields:
源码文档：A [`Command`] queue to perform structural changes to the [`World`].

Since each command requires exclusive access to the `World`,
all queued commands are automatically applied in sequence
when the `ApplyDeferred` system runs (see [`ApplyDeferred`] documentation for more details).

Each command can be used to modify the [`World`] in arbitrary ways:
* spawning or despawning entities
* inserting components on new or existing entities
* inserting resources
* etc.

For a version of [`Commands`] that works in parallel contexts (such as
within [`Query::par_iter`](crate::system::Query::par_iter)) see
[`ParallelCommands`]

# Usage

Add `mut commands: Commands` as a function argument to your system to get a
copy of this struct that will be applied the next time a copy of [`ApplyDeferred`] runs.
Commands are almost always used as a [`SystemParam`](crate::system::SystemParam).

```
# use bevy_ecs::prelude::*;
fn my_system(mut commands: Commands) {
   // ...
}
# bevy_ecs::system::assert_is_system(my_system);
```

# Implementing

Each built-in command is implemented as a separate method, e.g. [`Commands::spawn`].
In addition to the pre-defined command methods, you can add commands with any arbitrary
behavior using [`Commands::queue`], which accepts any type implementing [`Command`].

Since closures and other functions implement this trait automatically, this allows one-shot,
anonymous custom commands.

```
# use bevy_ecs::prelude::*;
# fn foo(mut commands: Commands) {
// NOTE: type inference fails here, so annotations are required on the closure.
commands.queue(|w: &mut World| {
    // Mutate the world however you want...
});
# }
```

# Error handling

A [`Command`] can return a [`Result`](crate::error::Result),
which will be passed to an [error handler](crate::error) if the `Result` is an error.

The fallback error handler panics. It can be configured via
the [`FallbackErrorHandler`](crate::error::FallbackErrorHandler) resource.

Alternatively, you can customize the error handler for a specific command
by calling [`Commands::queue_handled`].

The [`error`](crate::error) module provides some simple error handlers for convenience.
