schedule-access-74b9f11066063e31.name: MeshCullingDataBuffer
schedule-access-74b9f11066063e31.description: 提供 GPU 裁剪需要的网格 Aabb 缓冲；未使用 GPU 裁剪时保留空缓冲，避免 CPU 裁剪路径额外构建这些数据。
schedule-access-74b9f11066063e31.display_summary: 为 GPU 网格裁剪保存包围盒数据。
fields:
源码文档：A GPU buffer that holds the information needed to cull meshes on GPU.

At the moment, this simply holds each mesh's AABB.

To avoid wasting CPU time in the CPU culling case, this buffer will be empty
if GPU culling isn't in use.

potentially-visible and have [`NoCpuCulling`] components.

entities visible to each view.

schedule-access-c86318e663fe759a.description: 封装 GPU 队列，供准备阶段上传缓冲或纹理数据，并将待执行的 GPU 工作提交到设备。

bevy_egui::render::systems::prepare_egui_render_target_data_system：按 Egui 渲染视图整理绘制图元，计算物理裁剪矩形并排除视口外内容，把网格顶点和索引装入绘制缓冲；识别自定义绘制回调并保存延后准备项，解析目标格式与纹理引用。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_render::renderer::render_system：运行根 RenderGraph 调度，提交截图及 GPU 回读收尾命令，并呈现需要输出的窗口交换链；随后收集截图结果。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_render::mesh::allocator::allocate_and_free_meshes：先清空上帧分配块增长导致的迁移记录，再释放已移除或修改网格的旧存储，依据分配设置、顶点布局及本帧提取结果重新分配和写入网格数据。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::cluster::gpu::prepare_clusters_for_gpu_clustering：计算聚簇及各类对象数量，初始化元数据，按上次回读确定深度切片和索引容量，分配计数暂存并上传；同时建立统计回读状态，清理已消失视图的分配记录。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_pbr::cluster::gpu::upload_view_gpu_clustering_buffers：逐视图上传深度切片和聚簇元数据缓冲，保证偏移与计数暂存至少有一个元素后上传，使随后计算能够绑定非空缓冲。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::schedule::submit_pending_command_buffers：从 PendingCommandBuffers 取出已完成命令缓冲，仅在迭代器非空时提交 RenderQueue；启用追踪时记录本次提交的缓冲数量。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
bevy_core_pipeline::oit::init_oit_buffers：分配最小节点、像素链表头及原子计数器缓冲，上传容量参数并建立动态设置缓冲，插入 OitBuffers 资源以保证后续绑定具有有效初始存储。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。

源码文档：New-type for [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashSet::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashSet`], [`HashSet`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`](crate::hash::RandomState).
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.

fields:
源码文档：New-type for [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashSet::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashSet`], [`HashSet`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`](crate::hash::RandomState).
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.

fields:
源码文档：New-type for [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashSet::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashSet`], [`HashSet`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`](crate::hash::RandomState).
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.

源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

源码文档：New-type for [`HashMap`](hb::HashMap) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashMap`](hb::HashMap) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashMap::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashMap`], [`HashMap`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`].
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

声明字段／枚举项：
cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedRenderPipelineId>,
本实例类型参数：bevy_gizmos_render::pipeline_2d::LineGizmoPipeline

源码文档：`FixedBitSet` is a simple fixed size set of bits that each can
be enabled (1 / **true**) or disabled (0 / **false**).

The bit set has a fixed capacity in terms of enabling bits (and the
capacity can grow using the `grow` method).

Derived traits depend on both the zeros and ones, so [0,1] is not equal to
[0,1,0].

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedRenderPipelineId>,

源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

fields:
源码文档：Loads and tracks the state of [`Asset`] values from a configured [`AssetReader`](crate::io::AssetReader).
This can be used to kick off new asset loads and retrieve their current load states.

The general process to load an asset is:
1. Initialize a new [`Asset`] type with the [`AssetServer`] via [`AssetApp::init_asset`], which
   will internally call [`AssetServer::register_asset`] and set up related ECS [`Assets`]
   storage and systems.
2. Register one or more [`AssetLoader`]s for that asset with [`AssetApp::init_asset_loader`]
3. Add the asset to your asset folder (defaults to `assets`).
4. Call [`AssetServer::load`] with a path to your asset.

[`AssetServer`] can be cloned. It is backed by an [`Arc`] so clones will share state. Clones can be freely used in parallel.

[`AssetApp::init_asset`]: crate::AssetApp::init_asset
[`AssetApp::init_asset_loader`]: crate::AssetApp::init_asset_loader

源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

fields:
源码文档：A render-world resource that stores a list of [`Image`]s that will have
mipmaps generated for them.

You can add images to this list via the [`MipGenerationJobs::add`] method,
in the render world. Note that this, by itself, isn't enough to generate
the mipmaps; you must also add a [`generate_mips_for_phase`] system to the render schedule.

This resource exists only in the render world, not the main world.
Therefore, you typically want to place images in this resource in a system
that runs in the [`bevy_render::ExtractSchedule`] of the
[`bevy_render::RenderApp`].

See `dynamic_mip_generation` for an example of usage.
已核实使用场景：bevy_core_pipeline::mip_generation::prepare_mip_generator_pipelines：遍历已登记图像任务，为首次出现的已上传图像创建两阶段降采样绑定组、常量缓冲和专用化管线，按设备选择布局组合方式；格式不支持时记录错误，并清除本帧未使用任务的缓存。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。

schedule-access-ae9788febd5cd80a.name: SpecializedComputePipelines<DownsamplePipeline>
schedule-access-ae9788febd5cd80a.description: 将专用化键映射到缓存计算管线 ID，使不同配置生成相应描述，并复用已经构建的同键管线。 本实例类型参数为 bevy_core_pipeline::mip_generation::DownsamplePipeline。

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a compute pipeline based on some key.

Some compute pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different compute pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

声明字段／枚举项：
cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedComputePipelineId>,
本实例类型参数：bevy_core_pipeline::mip_generation::DownsamplePipeline

源码文档：The GPU buffers holding the data needed to render batches for a single
phase.

These are split out per phase so that we can run the phases in parallel.
This is the version of the structure that has a type parameter, which
enables Bevy's scheduler to run the batching operations for the different
phases in parallel.

See the documentation for [`BatchedInstanceBuffers`] for more information.

fields:
源码文档：A resource, part of the render world, that stores the GPU buffer that
specifies all the batch ranges that all invocations of the indirect
parameters building shader are to process.

This is a dynamic uniform buffer that stores instances of
[`IndirectParametersBuildJob`]. We could have used immediates instead of a
dynamic uniform buffer, but we want this to work on WebGPU, where immediate
support can't be guaranteed.
已核实使用场景：bevy_render::batching::gpu_preprocessing::prepare_indirect_parameters_build_jobs：清空旧任务与元数据，分别遍历各阶段索引及非索引批范围，生成动态参数任务，并按视图和阶段保存任务偏移及批数量，供后续计算着色器构建间接绘制参数。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_render::batching::gpu_preprocessing::write_indirect_parameters_build_jobs：将 IndirectParametersBuildJobs 已收集的任务动态参数写入渲染设备和队列，供构建间接绘制参数的计算阶段按偏移读取。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_pbr::render::gpu_preprocess::prepare_preprocess_bind_groups：按阶段工作项的直接、间接及遮挡裁剪模式，关联当前与前帧实例、视图、深度和裁剪缓冲，建立网格预处理绑定；同时准备间接参数、分桶解包和 Uniform 分配绑定。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。

schedule-access-37b7b738a1af4253.description: 追踪 ShaderBuffer 改为引用另一个底层缓冲的资产身份，供材质分配器使旧绑定组失效；仅内容改变无需加入该集合。
schedule-access-37b7b738a1af4253.display_summary: 记录底层 GPU 缓冲身份已变化的着色器缓冲。
fields:
源码文档：A render-world resource that stores the IDs of [`ShaderBuffer`]s that have
been updated to point at a different buffer.

The raw underlying buffer that a [`ShaderBuffer`] points to may change from
frame to frame. This will happen, for example, if the buffer represents a
CPU-managed vector that might grow. When this happens, the material bind
group allocator must invalidate any cached bind groups that referred to the
old buffer. This resource tracks those modified buffers to enable this
invalidation to happen.

Note that a [`ShaderBuffer`] will only be in this set if the *identity* of
the buffer that it wraps changed. If only the *contents* of the buffer
changed since last frame, then bind groups don't need to be updated, and the
shader buffer won't be present in this set.
已核实使用场景：bevy_render::material_bind_groups::prepare_material_bind_groups：遍历各材质绑定组分配器，结合管线布局、图像和采样器回退资源、已准备着色器缓冲及其变化记录，调用分配器准备或重建相应材质绑定组。 参数范围：RenderApp；只读声明。
已核实使用场景：bevy_render::storage::clear_changed_shader_buffers：清除 RenderChangedShaderBuffers，为本帧重新提取和准备着色器存储缓冲变化做准备，防止重复触发旧变化对应的材质绑定更新。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。

which can be used in place of [`FallbackImage`], when a fully transparent or black fallback

or alpha-blending it to other colors a no-op.

fields:
源码文档：LTC (Linearly Transformed Cosines) LUT textures for area light shading.

It is a texture array containing 2 LUT textures:
The first entry encodes the 4 non-trivial elements of the inverse GGX LTC matrix.
The second entry encodes amplitude and Fresnel-related weights.

[LUT source and fitting code](https://github.com/selfshadow/ltc_code/blob/master/fit/results)

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a render pipeline based on some key.

Some render pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different render pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

声明字段／枚举项：
cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedRenderPipelineId>,
本实例类型参数：bevy_core_pipeline::skybox::SkyboxPipeline

schedule-access-d9d5ccceb7659b61.display_summary: 按配置键缓存计算管线变体。
fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a compute pipeline based on some key.

Some compute pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different compute pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

声明字段／枚举项：
cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedComputePipelineId>,
本实例类型参数：bevy_pbr::ssao::SsaoPipelines
已核实使用场景：bevy_pbr::ssao::prepare_ssao_pipelines：把每台视图的质量级别与是否启用 TemporalJitter 组成专用化键，通过缓存取得环境光遮蔽管线并插入 SsaoPipelineId。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。
usageContexts: bevy_pbr::ssao::prepare_ssao_pipelines：把每台视图的质量级别与是否启用 TemporalJitter 组成专用化键，通过缓存取得环境光遮蔽管线并插入 SsaoPipelineId。 参数范围：RenderApp；可变声明。

schedule-access-4378d959f087fb9d.display_summary: 汇总当前视图已有和新提取的可见性类别。
fields:
源码文档：New-type for [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashSet::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashSet`], [`HashSet`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`](crate::hash::RandomState).
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.

schedule-access-876dfa0d82566677.name: HashSet<RetainedViewEntity>
schedule-access-876dfa0d82566677.description: check_views_need_specialization 在检查各视图的网格管线设置时登记保留视图身份，结束后从 ViewKeyCache 删除未再出现的视图。
schedule-access-876dfa0d82566677.display_summary: 记录本轮仍存在的三维网格视图。
fields:
源码文档：New-type for [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) with [`FixedHasher`] as the default hashing provider.
Can be trivially converted to and from a [hashbrown] [`HashSet`](hb::HashSet) using [`From`].

A new-type is used instead of a type alias due to critical methods like [`new`](hb::HashSet::new)
being incompatible with Bevy's choice of default hasher.

Unlike [`hashbrown::HashSet`], [`HashSet`] defaults to [`FixedHasher`]
instead of [`RandomState`](crate::hash::RandomState).
This provides determinism by default with an acceptable compromise to denial
of service resistance in the context of a game engine.
独立 Local 参数槽：seen_views
本地状态类型：bevy_platform::collections::hash_set::HashSet<bevy_render::view::RetainedViewEntity>

        Has<DistanceFog>,
        (
            Has<RenderViewLightProbes<EnvironmentMapLight>>,
            Has<RenderViewLightProbes<IrradianceVolume>>,
        ),
        (
            Has<OrderIndependentTransparencySettings>,
            Has<ExtractedAtmosphere>,
            Has<ScreenSpaceReflectionsUniform>,
            Has<ContactShadows>,
        ),
    )>,
    mut seen_views: Local<HashSet<RetainedViewEntity>>,
)

schedule-access-ee82cc967caae281.name: SpecializedComputePipelines<ClusteringZSlicingPipeline>
schedule-access-ee82cc967caae281.description: 将专用化键映射到缓存计算管线 ID，使不同配置生成相应描述，并复用已经构建的同键管线。 本实例类型参数为 bevy_pbr::cluster::gpu::ClusteringZSlicingPipeline。

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a compute pipeline based on some key.

Some compute pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different compute pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.

cache: HashMap<S::Key, CachedComputePipelineId>,
本实例类型参数：bevy_pbr::cluster::gpu::ClusteringZSlicingPipeline

schedule-access-c622635af33e8d7c.name: SpecializedComputePipelines<SparseBufferUpdatePipelines>
schedule-access-c622635af33e8d7c.description: 将专用化键映射到缓存计算管线 ID，使不同配置生成相应描述，并复用已经构建的同键管线。 本实例类型参数为 bevy_render::render_resource::sparse_buffer_vec::SparseBufferUpdatePipelines。

fields:
源码文档：A convenience cache for creating different variants of a compute pipeline based on some key.

Some compute pipelines may need to be configured differently depending on the exact situation.
This cache allows constructing different compute pipelines for each situation based on a key,
making it easy to A) construct the necessary pipelines, and B) reuse already constructed
pipelines.

Note: This is intended for modifying your pipeline descriptor on the basis of a key. If your key
contains no data then you don't need to specialize. For example, if you are using the
[`AsBindGroup`](crate::render_resource::AsBindGroup) without the `#[bind_group_data]` attribute,
you don't need to specialize. Instead, create the pipeline directly from [`PipelineCache`] and
store its ID.
